items.author: Deidrea
items.title: Gets the job done, but just okay
items.content: This works well for narrow drawers, but butter knives tend to slip under the walls of the organizer when opening and closing the drawer. This would be better if the walls were adheres to the organizer more securely and without gaps

items.author: Ivelisse
items.title: Falls Apart
items.content: Fell apart after a few days. It's held together by very small nails/,pins. Was tired of searching for an organizer that fit my drawer and didnt feel like returning it. Had to use wood glue to put it back together. Shouldn't have had to do all that to get it to work. So yeah. Im happy with it now but only because we put in the leg work to properly piece it together.

items.author: Bike Guy
items.title: Scam product, do not buy
items.content: This is a scam product. It is actually made of plastic and not bamboo as advertised.

items.author: Jerrie DeRose
items.title: Good quality only a very minor flaw
items.content: Liked the way the compartments are designed, fits perfectly in the drawer. Good solid wood. My only complaint is that the knives slide under a fine gap. Am going to use a wood skewer, put drop of wood glue on it and fill in the gap.

items.author: Ginny
items.title: Don't buy until they change the packaging
items.content: The tray seemed nicely made BUT it came wrapped in TOTALLY UNNECESSARY plastic wrap (it was packaged in a nice carboard box.) For those trying to avoid single-use plastic, DOM'T BUY THIS TRAY.

items.author: William
items.title: Find something else.
items.content: Only lasted me 3 months before it started disconnecting and falling apart.

items.title: Won’t hold full set of silverware.
items.content: Small and won’t hold full set of silverware. Small spoons won’t fit in the small space.

items.author: Lori
items.title: Cute but check your measurements!
items.content: Cute but much tinier than expected!

items.author: M Rochester
items.title: Does not fit knives not long enough
items.content: This does not fit kitchen butter knives in it. too small.

items.author: LD copycat
items.title: Not a silverware organizer
items.content: This was well constructed but regular silverware doesn’t fit in it. Only forks and spoons fit. Knives do not. Nothing fits in the small dividers. Maybe it can be used as a desk organizer?

items.author: Jc_Plates
items.title: Small and not enough compartments
items.content:
The material of this silverware organizer is pretty solid. It looks nice and sturdy. The compartments are not moveable. The biggest problem is the size. It has five compartments only, and the top two are very small. I am not sure what it can fit. As an Asian family, we have chopsticks, forks, spoons, soup spoons, knives, boba straws, etc. The three "bigger" compartments can fit only the standard length fork. Anything longer / bigger would not fit. That's the biggest problem.

Overall, it looks nice, but not functional. It may work for those who don't cook much at home, but not for a family of three or four.
authorLabels: Amazon Vine Customer Review of Free Product

items.author: Kal
items.title: Doesn't fit my flatware
items.content: Arrives wrapped. Seems to be decent quality. The wood is decent. It is very shallow so you can't stack a lot. My silverware didn't fit in it so it's kinda useless to me. I may use it in a desk drawer for pens and pencils etc. Seems better fitted for that.
